candidates.title: DfI granted planning permission for Belfast Transport Hub
candidates.summary: A Belfast City Council pre-determination hearing report records that the Department for Infrastructure granted planning permission in March 2019 for the Belfast Transport Hub, a new integrated public transport interchange on lands around Great Victoria Street, Grosvenor Road and Durham Street.
candidates.observed_change: Planning permission granted for an integrated transport interchange; this records approval only and does not claim construction or opening.
candidates.location_name: Belfast Transport Hub / Belfast Grand Central Station site, Great Victoria Street and Grosvenor Road
candidates.source_name: Pre-Determination Hearing Report for LA04/2021/2856/O, citing Belfast Transport Hub planning history
candidates.publisher: Belfast City Council, citing Department for Infrastructure decision
candidates.license: Unknown for council PDF; DfI Crown copyright likely OGL v3.0 for government decision material, verify before redistribution
candidates.limitations: The cited source is a later Belfast City Council report summarising the DfI permission; retrieve the original DfI decision notice before final ingestion. Approval does not prove construction progress or completion.
candidates.transformation_method: Manual extraction from official committee PDF; WGS84 coordinate approximated from named site centroid.
candidates.geometry_source: Manual geocoding from site address and named streets in official report

candidates.title: Weavers Cross outline mixed-use regeneration application recommended for approval
candidates.summary: The Belfast City Council addendum report for LA04/2021/2856/O states that the recommendation remained to approve outline permission for mixed-use regeneration around the new Belfast Transport Hub, subject to conditions and a Section 76 planning agreement.
candidates.observed_change: Official planning report recommendation to approve outline permission with reserved matters; this is not a final build-out or detailed design approval.
candidates.location_name: Weavers Cross, lands around Belfast Transport Hub, Durham Street and Grosvenor Road
candidates.license: Unknown public-sector committee PDF; verify reuse terms before redistribution
candidates.limitations: The report records a recommendation and conditions, not a completed decision notice or any physical works. Reserved matters including siting, design, external appearance, access and landscaping remained to be approved.
candidates.transformation_method: Manual extraction from official committee PDF; WGS84 coordinate approximated from application site description.
candidates.geometry_source: Manual geocoding from Durham Street/Grosvenor Road site description

candidates.title: Bank Buildings conservation-led restoration application reported to Planning Committee
candidates.summary: Belfast City Council's Planning Committee pack for November 2019 records applications LA04/2019/1903/F and LA04/2019/1905/LBC for conservation-led redevelopment and restoration of the Grade B1 Bank Buildings, including reinstatement of upper floor structures and facades after the 2018 fire.
candidates.observed_change: Official planning and listed-building-consent report for restoration works; do not treat as evidence that the restoration was complete on this date.
candidates.location_name: Bank Buildings, Royal Avenue, Castle Street and Bank Street
candidates.source_name: Public reports pack, Planning Committee, 12 November 2019
candidates.license: Unknown public-sector committee PDF; verify reuse terms before redistribution
candidates.limitations: Committee report recommended approval subject to matters such as conditions and drainage resolution; final decision notice should be retrieved from the Planning Portal. The event is an approval/reporting milestone, not completion of restoration.
candidates.transformation_method: Manual extraction from official committee report; coordinate approximated from named building and streets.
candidates.geometry_source: Manual geocoding from listed building/site address

candidates.observed_change: Listed building consent granted for facade-lighting works; this is not evidence that the lighting had been installed.
candidates.source_name: Planning Committee agenda and minutes, 17 February 2026
candidates.license: Unknown public-sector committee webpage/PDF; verify reuse terms before redistribution
